BENEFITS.HEADING: An Integrated Platform for Egyptian Teachers
BENEFITS.SUBTITLE: Designed with leading educators to simplify tutoring operations and center management.
BENEFITS.B1_DESC: Not generic AI — it analyzes your videos and PDFs to generate accurate questions directly from your material.
BENEFITS.B2_DESC: Every AI-generated exam and report must be approved by you before being sent to students or parents.
BENEFITS.B3_DESC: Weakness maps show exact student-level difficulties with actionable data.
BENEFITS.B4_DESC: An RTL-first Arabic interface built from the ground up for Egyptian educators and centers.
BENEFITS.B5_DESC: From sign-in to your first published lecture in two minutes without technical training.
BENEFITS.B6_DESC: Draya students improve their grades by an average of 31% within the first 3 months.

TESTIMONIALS.HEADING: Trusted by Hundreds of Teachers
TESTIMONIALS.T1_QUOTE: Draya saved me hours in preparing exams. The best part is the AI suggests but I approve — crucial for credibility with parents.
TESTIMONIALS.T2_QUOTE: Students track their own progress without me having to manually edit sheets. Reports reach parents faster and clearer.
TESTIMONIALS.T3_QUOTE: Parent reports used to take an entire day. Now they take minutes to review and approve. A real game changer.

FAQ.HEADING: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.Q1: Can I try Draya for free?
FAQ.A1: Yes, start with our Free Basic plan without a credit card. It supports up to 50 students and 2 courses.
FAQ.Q2: Is Draya fully available in Arabic?
FAQ.A2: Yes, completely. The platform is designed RTL-first for Egyptian teachers and students.
FAQ.Q3: How does AI work in Draya?
FAQ.A3: The AI analyzes lecture videos or PDFs and generates questions & reports for teacher approval before sending.
FAQ.Q4: Does the platform suit large centers?
FAQ.A4: Yes, our Enterprise plan is tailored for large centers with white-labeling, API integrations, and dedicated support.
FAQ.A5: We accept Visa, Mastercard, and Egyptian mobile wallets (Vodafone Cash, Orange Cash).
